airfoil2d_initial.density_formula: sqrt(0.1 + q95-normalized LSQ pressure gradient), divided by its native-grid mean
airfoil2d_initial.density_role: Policy refinement density before conditioning on the retained coarse set; uniform reference = 1
airfoil2d_initial.acquisition_state: initial geometry; native-index density fixed throughout design

airfoil2d_final.density_formula: sqrt(0.1 + q95-normalized LSQ pressure gradient), divided by its native-grid mean
airfoil2d_final.density_role: Policy refinement density before conditioning on the retained coarse set; uniform reference = 1
airfoil2d_final.acquisition_state: initial geometry; native-index density fixed throughout design

superwing_initial.density_formula: 1 + 8 * sqrt(normal-variation score normalized between q01 and q99), divided by its mean
superwing_initial.density_role: Actual PI sampling probability divided by uniform native-cell probability

superwing_final.density_formula: 1 + 8 * sqrt(normal-variation score normalized between q01 and q99), divided by its mean
superwing_final.density_role: Actual PI sampling probability divided by uniform native-cell probability
